units.source_text: 薰中纳言推想宇治的女公子一定望穿秋水。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, imagined that the young lady at Uji must be waiting for him with longing.

units.source_text: 追思起来，这正是他这媒人的过失，便觉十分抱歉。

en.t: Thinking back on it, he felt deeply sorry, realizing that this was truly his own fault as the go-between.

units.source_text: 因此他不断地访问匂亲王，探察他的心情。

en.t: For that reason, he kept visiting Prince Niou and tried to sound out his feelings.

units.source_text: 他看见匂亲王相思甚苦，知道不会断缘，便放心了。

en.t: Seeing that Prince Niou was suffering so painfully from love, he knew the bond would not be broken and felt relieved.

units.source_text: 九月十日左右，山野景色的凄凉可想而知。

en.t: Around the tenth day of the ninth month, one can imagine how desolate the mountains and fields must have looked.

units.source_text: 有一个傍晚，天色暗淡，风雨欲来，层云密布，阴沉可怕。

en.t: One evening, the sky was dim, wind and rain seemed about to come, and dense layers of cloud made everything dark and frightening.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心情特别恶劣，默坐沉思，一筹莫展，一心想赴宇治而不敢决行。

en.t: Prince Niou was in an especially wretched mood, sitting silently in thought with no plan at all, longing only to go to Uji but unable to bring himself to do it.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言猜测到他的心情，就在这时候来访问了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, guessed what was in his heart and came to visit at just that moment.

units.source_text: 他口吟“初秋风雨暴，山里复如何”的古歌，用以打动他的心。

en.t: He softly recited the old poem, "When early autumn winds and rains are fierce, how must it be in the mountain village," to stir the prince's heart.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不胜之喜，便劝他同行。

en.t: Prince Niou was overjoyed and urged him to go along.

units.source_text: 于是照例两人共乘一车出发。

en.t: So, as usual, the two set out riding together in one carriage.

units.source_text: 入山越深，越是想见山中人心情更多痛苦。

en.t: The deeper they went into the mountains, the more they could imagine how much greater the sorrow of those living there must be.

units.source_text: 两人一路上所谈的只是宇治两女公子的苦况。

en.t: All the two men talked about on the way was the suffering of the two young ladies at Uji.

units.source_text: 黄昏时分，四周更见沉寂，加之冷雨潇潇，这秋景异常凄凉。

en.t: At dusk, the surroundings grew stiller than ever, and with the cold rain falling softly, the autumn scene was unbearably bleak.

units.source_text: 衣衫被雨沾湿，衣香越是馥郁，似非人世之香。

en.t: Their robes were dampened by the rain, and their fragrance grew all the richer, seeming almost not of this world.

units.source_text: 这样的两个人联袂偕来，山中人安得不惊喜相迎呢！

en.t: When two such men arrived together, how could the people in the mountains fail to welcome them with astonished delight?

units.source_text: 众侍女近来常因亲王不来而啧有怨言，但此时全然忘却，大家笑逐颜开，连忙布设客座。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting had recently been grumbling because the prince had not come, but now they forgot all that, their faces brightened with smiles, and they hurried to prepare seats for the guests.

units.source_text: 早先这里的老侍女从京中找寻两三个曾在贵族邸内当差的女儿和侄女，叫她们来此服侍二女公子。

en.t: Earlier, the old lady-in-waiting here had searched in the capital for two or three daughters and nieces who had served in noble households and brought them here to attend the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 这些浅薄的少女向来看不起这孤寂的山庄，此时看见贵客临门，大家吃了一惊。

en.t: These shallow young women had always looked down on this lonely mountain villa, but now, seeing such noble guests arrive, they were all startled.

units.source_text: 大女公子此时看到匂亲王光临，也很欢喜。

en.t: The elder young lady, seeing Prince Niou come at this moment, was also very happy.

units.source_text: 然而看见那个爱管闲事的薰君跟着他同来，却觉得可羞，并且有些讨厌。

en.t: Yet when she saw that meddlesome Lord Kaoru had come with him, she felt embarrassed and even somewhat annoyed.

units.source_text: 但她把薰中纳言的雍容沉着的气概和匂亲王比较一下，便觉匂亲王终不及他的稳重，薰中纳言毕竟是个世间难得的男子。

en.t: But when she compared Kaoru the Middle Counselor's graceful, composed bearing with Prince Niou's, she felt that the prince was after all no match for his steadiness, and that Kaoru truly was a man rarely found in the world.
